title: Privacy Policy
heroSubheading: How Taraba State University collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

children.text: Taraba State University ("TSU," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of visitors to our website, prospective and current students, staff, and anyone who interacts with our online portals and services. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have, in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) 2023.
By using this website or any of our linked portals, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
Personal identification details (full name, date of birth, gender, state of origin, local government area) submitted through admission and application forms
Contact information (email address, phone number, postal address)
Academic records (O'level results, JAMB/UTME scores, transcripts, degree certificates, and other qualifications submitted for admission)
Payment information processed through our third-party payment gateway when you pay application, tuition, or other fees
Login credentials and activity when you use our student, applicant, or staff portals
Messages you send us through our contact form, including your name, email, and message content
We also automatically collect limited technical information when you visit our website, such as your browser type, device information, and pages visited, to help us maintain and improve the site.
We use the information we collect to:
Process and evaluate admission applications
Manage student registration, academic records, and results
Process payments for application, tuition, and other university fees
Communicate with you about your application, enrollment, or enquiries
Comply with regulatory and statutory obligations, including reporting to bodies such as the National Universities Commission (NUC)
Maintain the security and proper functioning of our website and portals
We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with:
Third-party payment processors, to securely process application and tuition payments
Service providers that operate our student and distance learning portals on our behalf
Government and regulatory bodies, where required by law, including JAMB, NUC, and NYSC
Email delivery providers, solely to send transactional emails such as contact form confirmations
Each of these third parties is only given the information necessary to perform their specific function, and is expected to handle it securely.

We retain personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, including satisfying any legal, accounting, or regulatory requirements. Academic records are generally retained for the duration of your studies and for a reasonable period afterward, in line with university record-keeping obligations.

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act, you have the right to access the personal information we hold about you, request correction of inaccurate information, request deletion of your information (subject to our legal and regulatory retention obligations), and object to certain uses of your information. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the details below.

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences and understand how visitors use our site. You can control cookies through your browser settings, though disabling them may affect some site functionality.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal, operational, or regulatory reasons. We will post the updated policy on this page with a revised effective date.
If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal information, please contact us at registrar@tsuniversity.edu.ng.
